name: Galicia
shortDescription: Tanky Spanish light cruiser with a balanced HE/AP main battery, tight gun dispersion, and Sonar that outranges Omaha's or Emerald's.
role: Balanced gun cruiser with a durability edge

stats.label: AA
stats.value: 77 DPS stock, 127 DPS upgraded across two mounts

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 5s action, 60s cooldown, unlimited charges. Same stock cycle as Omaha and Emerald, standard for the tier.

consumables.name: Sonar
consumables.flavor: 4 km ship detection, 3 km torpedo detection, 100s duration, 180s cooldown, 2 charges. Longer range and duration than Omaha's or Emerald's Sonar (3.7 km / 2.7 km over 90s).

torpedoMounts.label: Port
torpedoMounts.note: One launcher per broadside, fixed to that side with no centerline swing.

strengths: 27,800 hp upgraded beats Omaha (26,800) and Emerald (27,100), backed by the official Tough trait
Carries both HE and AP with a tight 2.15 sigma, so she isn't locked into one shell type like Emerald or Danae
Sonar reaches further than Omaha's or Emerald's, 4 km ship / 3 km torpedo detection over a full 100s
10.5 km sea detectability and the Hidden trait let her set her own engagement range
weaknesses: Only two torpedo mounts for six tubes total on an 88s reload, half the launcher count of Omaha or Emerald
Consumable slots stop at Damage Control Party and Sonar, no smoke, heal, or fighter option at all
10-76mm armor with an exposed citadel that HE shells punish just as easily as AP
Mediocre AA (127 DPS upgraded across just two mounts) with no Defensive AA Fire to lean on
tips: Use the good concealment to pick your range instead of brawling in close, the armor won't hold up to focused fire.
Don't count on the torpedoes as a primary weapon, two mounts and an 88s reload make them a bonus, not a plan.
Save Sonar for confirming a real threat, there's no fighter or smoke to fall back on if you burn both charges early.
Lean on HE against angled or bow-tanking targets since you're not locked into AP-only like Emerald or Danae.

threats.threat: Battleships and heavy cruisers with big AP
threats.reason: The exposed 10-76mm citadel gives them an easy hit even at range.
Only two torpedo mounts to answer with, and no smoke to break contact.
Mediocre AA and no Defensive AA Fire consumable leave plane attacks mostly unanswered.

summary: Tanky tier IV cruiser, more hull HP than Omaha or Emerald, backed by the Tough trait.
Balanced HE/AP main battery with tight dispersion instead of committing to one shell type.
Sonar that outranges Omaha's and Emerald's, an edge for spotting hidden threats.
Torpedoes are a light secondary threat, two triple mounts, not the main weapon.
Thin, exposed armor and mediocre AA sit behind that HP number.
playstyle.detail: Galicia trades torpedo volume for durability. Where Omaha and Emerald both carry four launcher mounts, Galicia gets by with two and leans instead on more hull HP than either of them and a main battery that doesn't have to choose between HE and AP. The 2.15 sigma keeps those eight guns landing close together, and Sonar here outranges the version they get. None of that fixes the armor, though. The citadel is just as exposed as her peers', the AA is weak, and the consumable kit stops at Damage Control Party and Sonar, no smoke or heal to lean on if a fight goes wrong.
